name: Claude Code Local Stack
description: Claude Code development environment wired to local Ollama inference. No cloud API keys required — all LLM calls route through localhost:11434. Includes memory, prompt engineering, and multi-agent coordination.
author: ai-lsc

tools.name: Claude Mem
tools.description: Persistent conversation memory layer for Claude Code sessions

tools.name: Claude Squad
tools.description: Multi-agent team orchestration for parallel Claude Code instances

notes.setup: Set CLAUDE_CODE_USE_BEDROCK=1 or configure claude-code to point at the Ollama endpoint. Anthropic Claude models are proxied through LiteLLM or Ollama's OpenAI-compatible API at localhost:11434.
notes.workflow: Claude Code → Ollama (localhost:11434) → local weights. Aider handles pair programming with the same endpoint. Fabric provides CLI text-processing pipelines.
